content.v: Link will see you now.
We are back with another look at the Japanese charts, courtesy of Famitsu , and it has been another big week for Nintendo.

On the software side of things, Nintendo Switch Sports Resort continues to lead the charge, holding onto its pole position from last week with another ~23,000 units to its name. The Switch 2 edition of Minecraft also makes its chart debut this time, grabbing a podium spot at third.

items.title: PC Gamer 杂志新一期现已发售：Metro 2039
items.summary: Plus, StarCraft, Diablo 5, Masters of Albion, Warhammer Blood Bowl, Valor Mortis, Endless Legend 2, Guns of Es

content.v: This month, PC Gamer delivers world-exclusive access to Metro 2039, the hyper-dark new FPS from 4A Games. And we're pleased to say that PC gamers who have been itching for the next great single-player FPS campaign are not going to be disappointed. This is shaping up to be a graphical powerhouse shooter that combines the best parts of each previous Metro game into a gripping, atmospheric FPS that pulls no punches in terms of action and narrative.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/43Fqu3eVcUVAjpsAnqg89B-1920-80.jpg
PC Gamer magazine: $4.99 Cover story: Metro 2039 | Secondary feature: Company of Heroes
This month, PC Gamer delivers world-exclusive access to Metro 2039. Plus, Diablo 5 previewed, Star Wars Galactic Racer reviewed, and top air coolers tested.
Buy this issue in print: $4.99 (US) | $16.49 (UK)
Buy this issue digitally: $4.99 (US) | $16.49 (UK)

There's another awesome feature in this issue of PC Gamer, too. On the long-running World War II RTS series' 20th anniversary, we speak directly to the developers who are currently looking after it and planning for its future, Relic Entertainment. And, with plenty of insider stories from the series past and present, this is a must-read for fans.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/GJb7PK7Z2gGmWr6JCmNq9A-1920-80.jpg

This issue is also loaded with great previews. First up we have our lead BlizzCon 2026 show report, which covers both Diablo 5 as well as the exciting new StarCraft FPS. This is followed by hands-on previews of Masters of Albion, Gundam Rogue Orbit, Guns of Eschaton, Warhammer Blood Bowl, Muramasa: Revenant Blades, and Crown of Hispania, among others.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/ZH4T8dqdaVwtthwTcPp33B-1920-80.jpg

Then, in terms of reviews, we pass our official judgement on the adrenaline-inducing Star Wars Galactic Racer, as well as Control Resonant, Endless Legend 2, Nighthawks, Valor Mortis, and Silent Hill: Townfall, among others.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/5zZjx8w6uqpyKL96dbjovA-1920-80.jpg
Cover feature: Metro 2039
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/S9bmsBPZMSCJA8JZqXzN6B-1920-80.jpg
Written by: Joshua Wolens
Magazine exclusive: Until November 26th, 2026

What's in this month's cover story: We get world-exclusive access to 4A Games and its gripping new FPS, Metro 2039. And we're pleased to say that, after lengthy interviews with the game's key developers, as well as behind-the-scenes access, we discover what looks set to be the next great single-player FPS campaign, one that combines the best bits of all previous Metro games into a hyper-dark, visually stunning adventure.
Secondary feature
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/XAgG5mMHfdYMaM9mjAc6fT-1920-80.jpg
Additional content in this month's issue
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/DkxbyRG2ehqpGLMZ2EVvGA.png
LEAD PREVIEW

Our lead preview this issue sees PC Gamer report in on the two biggest reveals from BlizzCon 2026. First, we dig into the dramatic reveal of a new single-player StarCraft FPS game and then, secondly, we explore everything we now know about Diablo 5. This is a great first look at what will no doubt be two highly anticipated games.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/HfxSz5i6obkan2vjZwbByU.png
LEAD REVIEW

Our lead review this issue sees PC Gamer buckle up and switch on the afterburner to keep pace with the adrenaline-inducing Star Wars Galactic Racer. And, with a fresh run-based roguelite campaign structure, we find there's plenty to enjoy at breakneck speed, even if the whole racing package is a little rough around the edges.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/P4V5AtzsN7o7xsVmBjqcNX.jpg
MOD SPOTLIGHT

Just when you'd think you had seen it all, some talented modder goes and splices slick first-person action-platformer Mirror's Edge into the wet-your-pants-scary horror game, Amnesia: The Bunker. The result is Bunker's Edge, and it is as great/crazy as you imagine.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/C3izDFtkRdF5gNvqQha2x9.png
REINSTALL

The epic story-based role-playing game that forces you, repeatedly, to make genuinely difficult choices gets replayed this issue to see if, ten years later, its unique fantasy world and characters inspired by Norse mythology still hit so hard.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/cxdAsyQBUU4gcggPk43fBd.jpg
DIARY

This issue of PC Gamer magazine sees us continue our Starfield diary where we attempt to play a deranged corpo serial killer in Starfield. Can Pendleton, whose axe loves to whisper sweet nothings in his ear, appear like a normal corporate suit during the day, while also racking up a huge body count at night? Pick up this issue to find out.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/WFS3utLbMni2vNntho4YMF.jpg
SPECIAL REPORT

This month's special report explores the talented, dedicated modders who are releasing fan English-language translations of classic, formerly Japanese-exclusive, Mystery Dungeon games such as Torneko's Great Adventure.
HARDWARE GROUP TEST

If you're a PC gamer who prefers to keep the cooling in your rig as simple and cheap as possible, eschewing water cooling solutions, then this month's group test is for you, with the PC Gamer hardware team testing out six of the best air coolers on the market today, from budget to premium.
...and more!
Now Playing : The PC Gamer team writes about their adventures in Bloodborne, Toem 2, Morels: The Hunt 2, and Beyond Good & Evil.
They're Back: Matthew Elliott re-reviews God of War, Dream Daddy: A Dad Dating Simulator, and Dead Rising 2.
Making of: Rick Lane speaks to the developers of the survival-driving hit Pacific Drive about how they went about creating its iconic station wagon.

items.summary: Hogwarts Legacy Build Version: 2153883 (Steam, EGS), 2153883 (Windows PC) DEVELOPER NOTES: This patch contains

content.v: Hogwarts Legacy Build Version: 2153883 (Steam, EGS), 2153883 (Windows PC)
DEVELOPER NOTES:

This patch contains some PC specific bugs fixes, additional device support, the latest up-sampling technologies from Nvidia and Intel, and it adds Nvidia’s DLSS 5 Neural Rendering technology with settings tuned by Avalanche for best visual results.

Neural Rendering is set to OFF by default, but the following support article explains how you can enable it: https://portkeygamessupport.wbgames.com/hc/en-us/articles/56349775286419 . Neural Rendering in Hogwarts Legacy requires a supported Nvidia GPU, currently Nvidia RTX 50 Series, and GeForce Game Ready Driver 616.64 or newer.
PATCH OVERVIEW:
Updated Nvidia upsampling to DLSS 5
Added Nvidia DLSS 5 Neural Rendering option for supported Nvidia GPU’s
Updated Intel XeSS version
Added support for Intel XeSS Multi-Frame Generation
Fixed an issue which caused certain graphics options to save incorrectly in some scenarios
Added support for Steam Deck OLED and Steam Machine, including optimized graphical settings and virtual keyboard
Added support for NVIDIA RTX Spark Laptop
Updated minimum required GPU driver notifications
Reduced the need to restart the game due to changing certain Frame Gen options

content.v: https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261105/1793857167_101174.png
毁灭倒计时已经开始……准备迎接哥斯拉!
今天，EA 和 Respawn 正式公布了《Apex 英雄》的最新联动内容。东宝旗下的经典怪兽将降临风暴点，带来全新的 《Apex 英雄》× 哥斯拉活动，并将于 11 月 10 日在全平台上线。
在这场限时活动中，玩家可以在哥斯拉肆虐后留下的混乱战场中与对手展开激战，同时借助哥斯拉的力量，在战场上留下一路毁灭的痕迹。
点击此处观看官方 《Apex 英雄》× 哥斯拉活动实机预告片：
https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1NxxX64EE2/
本次限时联动将带来丰富的全新内容，包括：
- 外卡模式接管
● 风暴点正遭受哥斯拉的猛烈袭击。哥斯拉肆虐后留下的破损建筑、烧焦的树木、倒塌的路牌，以及其他破坏痕迹散布在整张地图上，而哥斯拉本体则盘踞于上空。
● 在哥斯拉释放热射线之前，胆敢进入爆炸范围的玩家将发现一个补给仓，并有机会获取一把特殊的暴走轻机枪。该武器拥有威力惊人的热射线攻击，命中敌人时还能追踪其位置。
- 全新通用神话级近战武器
● 挥舞哥斯拉力量的一部分——背鳍匕首。这款近战武器的设计灵感源自哥斯拉标志性的背鳍，并附带配套的死亡箱外观。
- 哥斯拉主题外观
● 通过 10 款全新传奇外观，展现你对哥斯拉宇宙的热爱!这些外观不仅汲取了经典哥斯拉系列作品的灵感，还融入了一些致敬系列历史的经典元素：
○ 寻血猎犬：2026 版哥斯拉
○ 瓦尔基里：2003 版魔斯拉
○ 恶灵：2016 版哥斯拉
○ 探路者：1974 版机械哥斯拉
○ 疯玛吉：戴斯特洛伊亚
○ 罗芭：太空哥斯拉
○ 地平线：1995 版哥斯拉
○ 亡灵：1993 版超级机械哥斯拉
○ 催化剂：1991 版王者基多拉
○ 动力小子：杰特杰格
- 全新活动通行证
● 完成活动通行证，即可通过免费和高级两条奖励路线，获取更多哥斯拉主题奖励，包括全新徽章、制造金属、追踪器、武器外观等丰富内容。
- 以及更多精彩内容!
